description: The queue behind agents that run on your own AI through a Runner: which agent was woken about which record, why (reason), how many events merged into it (coalesced_count) and ONE derived run_state, computed by the server and not meant to be recomputed (needs_approval, running, done, failed, canceled, waiting_for_runner, runner_offline, waiting_for_limit, waiting_for_hours, waiting_for_reserve, waiting_for_budget, waiting_for_turn). Filter with agent and record. Only wakes whose record and agent you can read are listed. Waking, claiming and finishing a wake are not tools. [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES list_agent_wakes"]

agent.description: The agent record's uuid (from the Agents database).

database.description: The database of `record`, only needed when `record` is a public number.

record.description: A record uuid, or its public number when `database` is given.

name: list_agent_wakes
title: List the agent wake queue
